patterns.pattern: Never detect a signal without scoring it
patterns.description: If you add whale/smart-money detection, it MUST add to gem_score AND flow to position sizer. Logging only = dead signal. Check: detect → score → size.

patterns.pattern: Whale signals must cascade: score boost + sizing bonus
patterns.description: moralis_exp_net_buyers_1w >= 10 → +15 gem_score AND 1.35x position size. Both must be wired end-to-end: gem_scanner -> main.py -> offensive_guardrails. Always verify the call site passes the new params.

patterns.pattern: Always use SSH for Hetzner VPS — never web console for passwords
patterns.description: Hetzner web console (VNC) mangles numeric password input. The password 113014 consistently fails via web console regardless of input method. SSH to root@5.161.126.32 with password 113014 is the only reliable deployment path.

patterns.pattern: docker compose down does NOT wipe trade data — bind mounts survive
patterns.description: ./data:/app/data and ./logs:/app/logs are bind mounts to host filesystem at /root/shamrock-trading-bot/. docker compose down + up never touches these. P&L, positions.json, trade_log.json all survive rebuilds.

patterns.pattern: All indicator fallback values must be neutral (50), never zero
patterns.description: Using 0 as fallback for missing indicators zeroes out the weighted composite score. Always use 50 (neutral/average). This was the root cause of all gems scoring below MIN_GEM_SCORE when data was unavailable.

patterns.pattern: All dynamically-set GemCandidate attributes must be declared as dataclass fields
patterns.description: Setting attributes like candidate.moralis_exp_net_buyers_1w without declaring them in the dataclass causes AttributeError in some Python versions and breaks IDE introspection. Always add new fields to data/models.py GemCandidate with a default value.

patterns.pattern: Always cancel unfinished ThreadPoolExecutor futures explicitly on timeout
patterns.description: Using concurrent.futures.as_completed with a timeout leaves dangling futures if not cancelled. Always catch TimeoutError, iterate remaining futures, and call future.cancel() before pool shutdown. This prevents 'N futures unfinished' log noise.

patterns.pattern: 44% win rate — need trade-level loss categorization to improve
patterns.description: Current win rate is below 50%. Root cause unknown without per-loss analysis. Need to log: chain, gem_score at entry, score components, exit reason (hard stop vs trailing vs TP) for every closed trade. Hypothesis: Solana meme coins with no RugCheck data are dragging win rate down.
